subject.title: Preserve legacy watch resume semantics for GUID-linked URL previews

question: Should folded watch events preserve legacy `--since-rowid` semantics through an internal completion boundary and defer a public `cursor` unless both tokens have equivalent proven reconnect behavior?
rationale: The prior implementation was intentionally closed because this is a public compatibility-contract choice, not a mechanical coalescing fix alone.

options.title: Preserve legacy `id`; defer public cursor
options.body: Keep the physical completion boundary internal so existing consumers resume safely, and introduce no new public token until its semantics are independently justified.

options.title: Ship an additive cursor contract
options.body: Expose `cursor` only while retaining legacy `id` mapping and adding explicit documentation plus reconnect tests for both tokens.

recommendation.title: Preserve legacy `id`; defer public cursor
recommendation.body: Keep the physical completion boundary internal so existing consumers resume safely, and introduce no new public token until its semantics are independently justified.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior closure identifies this person as the reviewer who surfaced the unresolved resume-contract decision.
